responsibility: Defines the LM32 backend’s machine constraints used by reload, instruction selection, and asm operand validation. It classifies immediates and symbolic forms specific to the architecture—such as zero, one, signed and unsigned 16-bit literals, shifted high-half constants, small-data symbols, and HIGH forms of symbol addresses—so that patterns in lm32.md and address legality code can distinguish encodable operands from those requiring synthesis.
